statement: The WiiBrew Extension Controllers identification section notes that an integrated/inbuilt MotionPlus may present an unencrypted inactive six-byte extension identity 01 00 A6 20 00 05, distinct in its leading byte from the 00 00 A6 20 00 05 external/inactive variant. The text qualifies this as a possible observation, not a universal discriminant or definitive early non-TR Wii Remote Plus identifier.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 121955 section Identification and oldid 120079 introductory MotionPlus identification; do not collapse hardware generations based on one community-documented ID.
